# Polingual

> Polingual is an app for iPhone and iPad that teaches several languages at once. Each word returns in every language of your set, in one spaced review queue. 29 languages, from Spanish and Japanese to Latin, Sanskrit and Old English. Published by AGFarms LLC.

- Placement runs once per language, so you skip words you know.
- Spaced review mixes all your languages in one queue.
- You hear each word and say it back; Apple speech recognition checks it.
- Progress syncs with Bucket (bucket.foundation) when you sign in with the same email.
- Status: free beta on TestFlight for iPhone and iPad, joined from polingual.com. The App Store release follows Apple review.
- Price after launch: $9.99 a month or $59.99 a year, each with a 3-day free trial.
